summary: Live 9-category founder audit — categories 3 (Reliability), 4 (Performance), 5 (Data/malformed), 6 (QA re-verify of 5 fixes), 8 (UX), plus lightweight 9 (Cost/BI). 12/12 backend audit tests PASS + TestBootGapRealRestart PASS separately. Live UI probe of cold-start chat + revoked-token surfacing confirms user-facing behavior is clean. One real UX friction found on login screen (cookie banner overlay covers primary submit button on desktop 1440x900).

minor.issue: Observed 1/6 flaky ~60s 502 Cloudflare gateway-timeout on longcat+claude review path (prompt 'What is 2+2?'). Not reproducible in 5 subsequent retries. The friendly-status-retry hook exists client-side, but backend p99 for the review path is at/near the ingress timeout budget — worth measuring latency budget on the longcat+claude branch specifically.
Non-blocking: some legacy session_ids in the preview DB contain deleted messages (empty payload). No error, just note.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'We use cookies to improve your experience' banner overlays the primary 'Sign in' submit button on desktop 1440x900. First-time users clicking submit before dismissing cookies hit the banner instead; the form silently no-ops (email may even revert to placeholder). Accepting cookies fixes it. Suggest either moving the cookie banner to bottom-left/right corner as a small toast, or z-index-ordering it below the form's action button. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/screenshots/ux_01_login.png
ui_bugs.selector: .cookie-banner (via 'We use cookies to improve your experience' text)

issues: Positive finding: the 'GitHub access revoked' banner at the top is exceptionally clear and includes a direct 'Reconnect GitHub App' CTA — no friction here.

Secondary warning banner ('26 projects point to deleted or unreachable repos — click to clean up') is prominent and helpful, but firing on every session render may become noise; consider dismiss+snooze.

action_items: MEDIUM UX: fix cookie-banner overlaying the Sign-in submit button on desktop viewports (login page). Simple z-index / repositioning change.

LOW REL: investigate the occasional 60s+ latency on chat/send when the longcat+claude review path is invoked. Consider a server-side abort budget < 55s to guarantee a friendly-fail response rather than Cloudflare 502.
NO-OP CONFIRMED: revoked-token GitHub failure path returns a clean actionable message end-to-end (backend + UI). No fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: chat/send has an ~14-22s typical latency even for trivial prompts because the intent-router+longcat+claude pipeline runs unconditionally for chat mode. If founder wants sub-5s 'hi' latency, add a shortcut to bypass the review pass for detected greetings (already partially exists per session-1 turn returning in <1s the second time).
Login form submit button has no data-testid — recommend adding data-testid='login-submit' to reduce future selector churn.
Cookie banner has no data-testid on the 'Accept all' button (had to select by text) — same recommendation.

success_rate.frontend: cold-start chat OK, revoked-token surfacing OK, 1 UX friction found

test_credentials: test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! (admin/founder), free-gate-test-0822@aurem.dev / FreeGateTest2026! (free non-admin) — both work.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only created ephemeral chat sessions (audit_*, coldstart_*, rel_*, math_*, probe_*, revoked_probe_* prefixed session_ids) belonging to test_admin_001. No data-mutating writes to findings/projects/config.

cat_3_reliability.third_party_failure_github_revoked: CONFIRMED CLEAN. GET /cto/projects/p_demo_a/check-pat → {state:'expired', message:'PAT rejected by GitHub — please rotate.'}. GET /cto/projects/p_demo_a/tree → 401 {'detail':'GitHub PAT invalid or expired'} fast-fail. POST /chat/send with project_id=p_demo_a → 200 in 13-15s with content: 'GitHub access to `aurem-demo/frontend` was revoked — reconnect this repo from the project settings to restore access. ...To fix: 1. Go to project settings 2. Reconnect the GitHub repo 3. Once reconnected, I\'ll be able to read any file you need.' UI shows a prominent amber 'Reconnect GitHub App' banner. No hang, no 500.
cat_3_reliability.llm_orchestrator_timeout: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED. Typical chat/send completes in 14-22s with 'friendly status masking' hook. Observed one 502 (Cloudflare ingress ~60s timeout) out of ~6 sends — the backend was still processing on the longcat+claude branch. Recommend adding a server-side abort budget under 55s to translate to a friendly retry rather than an ingress 502.

cat_4_performance.verdict: Both endpoints handle 15-20 concurrent hits comfortably under 1s p95 with 0% error rate.

cat_5_data_malformed.oversized_25k_prompt: PASS — returns clean 4xx (422), not 500 or hang.

cat_6_qa_reverify_5_fixes.SEC001_execute_bash_shell_injection: CONFIRMED via code inspection (/app/backend/services/local_tools.py has argv-only exec markers). Not testable from HTTP (founder-only local tool).
cat_6_qa_reverify_5_fixes.SEC002_chat_sessions_user_scoping: CONFIRMED — admin session list ∩ free-user session list = ∅. Free user requesting an admin session's chat/history returns empty messages (not a leak).
cat_6_qa_reverify_5_fixes.boot_gap_race_condition_TestBootGapRealR: CONFIRMED PASS — ran the real supervisorctl-restart regression test: `backend/tests/test_maintenance.py::TestBootGapRealRestart::test_real_restart_logs_outage_with_correct_duration PASSED` in 15.20s.
cat_6_qa_reverify_5_fixes.ship_fix_cold_start_mismatch_guard: CONFIRMED — fresh session_id sends 'hi' and receives 'Hello! I\'m AUREM — your senior engineering co-pilot...' with no 'mismatch guard' / 'coldstart mismatch' / 'fetch_file signature' error anywhere in response or DOM.
cat_6_qa_reverify_5_fixes.findings_to_fix_bridge_phase1_matched: CONFIRMED — GET /findings/backlog?project_id=p_demo_a&ids=<id> returns a 'matched' array (list type) in the response payload.

cat_8_ux.cold_start_chat_reliability: CONFIRMED — first message in brand-new session responds cleanly in ~20s. No blank screen, no error, no mismatch-guard.
cat_8_ux.blank_screen_after_ship: NOT TESTED — no project in preview DB has a working GitHub write path (p_demo_a=revoked, p_demo_b=has_pat:false, all TEST_Proj_* point to owner/test-repo which is fabricated). This matches main agent's prior note. Cannot exercise ship without either (a) a real repo with a valid PAT in preview or (b) mocking the GitHub client. Recommend seeding one working (small) demo repo + PAT in preview for future audit passes.
cat_8_ux.other_friction: Cookie banner overlays 'Sign in' submit button on desktop 1440x900 (see ui_bugs). Login form fields lack data-testid attributes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The full audit test file /app/backend/tests/test_audit_2026_01_full_stack.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. It uses _get_retry() for GET endpoints to tolerate Cloudflare 502 transients. TestBootGapRealRestart in test_maintenance.py performs a real supervisorctl restart — do not run it in parallel with other backend tests that assume backend is up.
